announcements.headline: Half-year Report
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a scheduled half-year financial report, which provides shareholders with an update on the company's performance and financial position for the first six months of the fiscal year.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a director or person discharging managerial responsibilities has dealt in the company's shares, which is a routine disclosure of personal trading activity. It provides limited insight into the company's operational performance but confirms compliance with insider dealing regulations.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a scheduled Annual General Meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments and auditor mandates. It signifies standard corporate governance compliance rather than any material change to the company's strategic or financial position.
